Taking care of your health just got easier – start here with my sponsor Zocdoc: https://zocdoc.com/RyanPlus

Today we're covering some of the strangest headlines on the internet, including a fake bear insurance scam, a dog that accidentally fired a shotgun, another dog that somehow fired a gun, a gaming PC that stopped a bullet, and a delivery driver accused of taking a family's cat. Somehow, all of these are real news stories.
